This is an aircraft which engenders superlatives: 23 miles-a-minute, faster than a bullet at almost twice the height of Mt. Everest, and
with more than 5.000 hours of test tight behind her. This is Concorde
unprecedented in its levels of operational excellence. Since
its inaugural commercial flight on 21st January 1976, more than one million passengers have flown the British Airways Concorde.
